$comment: Source is TypeScript now (src/host/*.ts, src/client/*.ts), and every .ts file is type-checked unconditionally — `checkJs` only governs plain .js files, of which src/ has none (a .js under src/ would need a top-level '// @ts-check' pragma to be checked at all). strict/noImplicitAny stay false, so untyped parameters are implicit-any and pass: the ONE shape that does not is a parameter WITH a default initializer, which is typed from that initializer — give it an explicit annotation instead of JSDoc (in a .ts file `@param`/`@type` are comments, not type sources; see src/host/lifecycle.ts). noEmit:true means this check never produces artifacts — the build is tsdown's job (test/build-gate.mjs). Run it with `npm run typecheck`; it is deliberately NOT part of `npm test`.
